section: 5th Floor, Mantri Sterling, Plot No. 341,    Survey No. 997/8, Model Colony,    Near Deep Bungalow Chowk,    Pune - 411 016 [ What are the charges to be paid while submitting Form 49A/ 49AA? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-06)   1. **If Physical PAN Card is required:**   While submitting PAN application form, applicant will have to indicate whether physical PAN card is required. If applicant opts for physical PAN Card, then physical PAN card will be printed & dispatched at communication address. The e-PAN card in PDF format will be dispatched at e-mail ID mentioned in PAN application form, if the same is provided.
